nora: Quick Q  we're finalizing an international adoption under the Hague Convention. Child arrived in the US on 2026-03-02 but passport/SSN paperwork is still pending. We missed open enroll. Can we add the child now and backdate coverage to arrival?

erin (Benefits): Huge congrats!! :tada: Hague adoptions are QLEs. We can provisionally enroll based on USCIS receipts (I-800/I-800A or I-600/I-600A), adoption decree, and the child's passport/immigration entry doc. SSN can be provided later.

lucas (People Ops): Checklist: 1) Submit Add Dependent in HiBob, 2) attach USCIS receipt + Hague approval letter + adoption decree, 3) set event date to 2026-03-02 (arrival date). We'll mark record as pending SSN.

nora: We have I-800 approval PDF and the adoption decree, but the local registrar hasn't issued a US passport yet. Is the USCIS entry stamp enough?

erin (Benefits): Yes the I-800 approval and the I-94/US entry stamp are usually fine for provisional enrollment. Carrier might ask for passport/SSN later. Upload everything and note "SSN pending - passport pending".

nora: If they approve retro to 3/02, how will payroll handle retro premiums? I prefer to spread any retro over multiple paychecks if possible.

devin (Payroll): We can prorate retro deductions. Payroll windows are 1-15 and 16-end. If Benefits finalizes before the payroll cutoff (the 15th for the mid-month run) we can include retro in the next pay; otherwise it will show the following cycle. We can usually split the retro across up to 2 pay periods on request. Put "split retro over 2 pays" in HiBob and tag @devin.

nora: Thank you. Also, are there extra translation/legalization requirements for overseas adoption paperwork? Docs are in Spanish and include Hague apostille.

erin (Benefits): Apostille is perfect. For non-English docs we need a certified translation or an embassy letter confirming the document. Since you have the apostille and USCIS approval, translations should be straightforward. Upload translations if available; otherwise upload the apostille and we'll accept provisional docs.

nora: Submitted now with I-800, decree, I-94, apostille, and a note asking to split retro. Thanks all! :heart:

erin (Benefits): Received. We'll provisionally enroll and escalate any carrier-specific requests. Expect confirmation within 2 business days. If carrier requires SSN later we'll follow up and mark the record pending.

lucas (People Ops): I'll keep an eye on the escalation. Ping this thread if you don't hear back in 48 hours.

devin (Payroll): Once Benefits finalizes, I'll flag payroll for retro split.

nora: Appreciate the quick help  means a lot.
